name: Indomethacin 25mg 30 Capsules
description: Indomethacin is used to relieve pain, tenderness, inflammation, and stiffness caused by osteoarthritis (arthritis caused by wear and tear of the joint lining), rheumatoid arthritis (arthritis caused by inflammation of the joint lining), and spondylitis. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
